description: Send a general message to the IG Digital Lab team on behalf of a person: a project question, a quote request, a request for a call or any other note. Use it for anything that is not an order for the free audit; for the audit use request_free_audit instead. Only call this when the person has explicitly asked to be contacted and has given their real name, a message and a real phone or email. The message goes to a human.

email.description: Email address. Give this or phone.

message.description: What they need, in their own words.

name.description: Full name of the person getting in touch.

phone.description: Phone number. Give this or email.

name: submit_contact_request
title: Send a message to IG Digital Lab
